device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD H.265/HEVC combo receiver with CI slot, CA card reader, Ethernet and USB Wi-Fi
device.board: 6C000A00 (bootloader version "M3529A 1.1.1", 256 MB DDR3 C3505 combo platform)
device.soc: ALi M3529A / C3505 with 256 MB DDR3 (maincode "ALI_C3505:0x%x", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200)
device.demod: internal DVB-S2 (NIM_S3505_0) + external Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C on SCB3 at I2C 0x14
device.tuner: Airoha AV2012 at I2C 0x61 (DVB-S2) + MaxLinear MxL608 at I2C 0x60 (DVB-T2/C)

source.note: Archive Amiko_HD8265_1.3.63_mcas.abs from AMIKO HD8265+; added for expanded coverage.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB DDR3 C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_hd8265_v1515_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8265_v1515_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80000200 and seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 (224 MB physical DDR), sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR (restoring 0xBFE00000 to the 0xBF800000..0xBFFFFFFF flash mirror), and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application initialises its external Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C demodulator at I2C 0x14 on SCB3 ("Demod is 6762!!!", demods.py:AVL6762), Airoha AV2012 DVB-S2 tuner at I2C 0x61 on SCB1 and MaxLinear MxL608 DVB-T2/C tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB3, drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 108 (" ON ", " on "), populates its blank userdb(64+64) partition from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Amiko HD8265+ (System ID 6C000A00) firmware v.1.5.15 with the Edision GUI (2020-12-4) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3529A / C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Pairs the C3505's internal DVB-S2 demodulator + Airoha AV2012 tuner (0x61 on SCB1) with an external Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C demodulator (0x14 on SCB3, chip_id 0x0E) + MaxLinear MxL608 tuner (0x60 on SCB3), and drives a CH455 front-panel LED controller on GPIO 107 / 108.
